text.en: These Regulations may be cited as the National Registration (Transitional Provisions) Regulations. Persons to be re-registered.

Every person within Brunei Darussalam to whom identity card or replacement thereof has been issued in accordance with the provisions of the National Registration Regulations (hereinafter referred to as the Principal Regulations) and who has not reregistered since 30th day of November 1974 shall, not later than 1st day of July 1979, report to a Registration Officer and re-register. Offence.

(1) Any person who fails to comply with the provisions of regulation 2 shall be guilty of an offence: Penalty, imprisonment for 2 years and a fine of $5,000.

(2) An offence under sub-regulation (1) shall be a seizable offence for the purpose of the law relating to criminal procedure.
